name: openbb_fixedincome_treasury_auctions
description:
US Treasury auction results (CUSIP, term, dates, high yield or rate, bid-to-cover) from TreasuryDirect through the OpenBB Platform (obb.fixedincome.government.treasury_auctions).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): security_type (bill, note, bond, cmb, tips or frn; default note); start_date; end_date; limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (government_us; default government_us).
Yields: openbb_treasury_rates, openbb_yield_curve. Keys: government_us needs none.
Example: {"security_type": "bill", "start_date": "2026-09-01"}

security_type.description: bill, note, bond, cmb, tips or frn

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
